faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.contact: Still stuck? Write to us at <email>support@under10.app</email>

items.a: For eaters, yes — always. Restaurants pay €19/month (or €190/year) after a 7-day free trial to get the Official page and owner tools.
Everywhere in Europe. Spots are added by the community, so big cities fill up first. If your town is empty, add the first spot and earn 20 points.

items.q: How do you know the prices are right?
items.a: Every price is checked by people who were there. Tap “I was there” within 1 km to confirm it, or suggest a new price if it changed. Two matching suggestions update it automatically.
No. You can browse the map, spots and the Explore feed as a guest. You need a free account to add spots, like, verify, save and post.
Because that’s the hard part. Anyone can find a €25 restaurant. Under10 is about eating well when money is tight, anywhere you go.

items.q: Can I post videos and stories?
items.a: Yes. Add photos and videos up to 1 minute to any spot, and post stories that disappear after 24 hours.

items.q: I own a restaurant. How do I get the Official badge?
items.a: Download the app, create a restaurant account, find your restaurant, send a proof (Kbis or invoice) and start your 7-day free trial in the app.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: In Settings → Delete account. Everything you posted is deleted for good. Spots others also used stay on the map without your name.

items.a: 7 days free, then €19/month or €190/year. No commission, cancel anytime. If you stop, your spot stays on the map as a community spot, without the Official badge and owner tools.

items.q: What if my prices are over €10?
items.a: Your page stays yours, but the map only shows restaurants with at least one meal under €10. Set that meal as your map price.
You can’t delete community photos, but you can report any photo that breaks our rules and we’ll review it.
Tap “Mark as closed”. Your page shows “Temporarily closed” and leaves the map until you reopen.
